compute_des_pose: convert a GraspNet grasp object to robot coordinates returning grasp point, approach delta, and orientation quaternion
grasp_to_pose: extract the translation and quaternion orientation from a graspnetAPI.Grasp object
min_dist_grasp: find the grasp with minimum orientation distance to a reference end-effector quaternion
min_dist_grasp_no_z: find the grasp with minimum orientation distance to a reference quaternion disregarding z-axis rotation
GraspingRobotInterface_grasp: execute a robot grasp by opening the gripper, moving to the approach and grasp positions, then closing the gripper
